svg.title: Minimum-variance frontier
svg.desc: Expected growth rate against growth-rate standard deviation, both in inverse years. The solid red upper branch is the efficient frontier. Portfolio p2, marked by a blue filled circle at the vertex, is the global minimum-variance portfolio. Portfolios p1 and p3 have the same risk. An upward arrow at their shared standard deviation shows the higher expected growth of p1. Portfolio p3 is an open circle on the gray dashed dominated branch. This is a schematic with short positions allowed, not fitted data.
